description_en: Deletes a specified enhanced VPN gateway
description_zh: 调用DeleteEnhancedVpnGateway接口删除指定的增强型VPN网关
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-enhanced-vpn-gateway --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteEnhancedVpnGateway

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
增强型 VPN 网关实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.
The client generates the value of this parameter. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length. If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。
由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enhanced VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh: 增强型 VPN 网关实例的 ID
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id
